text:
maria-cs: Day0 smoke for Bridgehead private deploy — quick scrub on NAT, route tables, KMS access, and audit-forwarding. Any blockers?
oliver-se: VPC peering is up but routes to telemetry subnet missing. Can paste route table.
jess-eng: route table check: `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc123` — no route for 10.10.5.0/24 -> transit gateway.
raj-infra: pushed route to TGW ~5m ago. Console shows propagation status 'propagating' on rtb-3345 — should settle in a few mins.
maria-cs: @raj-infra confirm it completes before EOD? We need Week0 clean for renewal review next week.
raj-infra: will confirm. Also flag: KMS key policy currently allows only account root. Customer expects cross-account decrypt from ops role `arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/bridge-head-ops`. I'll update policy to allow that + log to their SIEM.
jess-eng: +1. Typical policy snippet I add: 
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowOpsRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/bridge-head-ops"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
oliver-se: Audit logs note: customer wants org-level CloudTrail to S3 in their account. Confirm bucket uses CMK `alias/rdw-bridgehead-audit` and bucket policy allows CloudTrail PutObject.
maria-cs: Do we have checklist for S3 lifecycle & access? Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-onboard#audit
raj-infra: Bucket exists, encryption set to customer CMK, bucket policy had a Deny for anonymous — looks fine. I don't see CloudTrail writes yet; maybe CloudTrail wasn't fully initialized.
deploy-bot: cloudtrail_create_event: Trail "bridgehead-audit" created at 2026-01-15T14:02Z
jess-eng: If trail exists, verify CloudTrail IAM role can write to bucket and that the CloudTrail service principal is allowed. Recommend SNS alarm on DeliveryFailure (30m).
maria-cs: Risk: If KMS cross-account policy isn't approved by Friday, renewal flags will escalate (affects SLA). @oliver-se add to risk register.
oliver-se: Added: "KMS policy pending customer approval" with mitigations: temp fallback using our audit key (needs contract amendment). ETA from customer?
maria-cs: PM said "earliest Thursday" — I'll set follow-up call Thu 10:30 UTC.
raj-infra: Validation command for customer: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --key-id alias/rdw-bridgehead-audit` — send output if it fails.
jess-eng: Ran smoke after policy tweak: decrypt succeeded. CloudTrail showed S3 PutObject 403 — fixed by adding explicit statement for `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` in bucket policy.
maria-cs: Update onboarding doc with final policy snippet and mark "audit log ingestion" done.
oliver-se: One remaining network item: telemetry egress to our collector on 443. NAT GW allows 443 egress, but collector requires their IP whitelist.
raj-infra: Customer needs to whitelist our IP 34.55.66.77 on their collector SG. Requested whitelist; awaiting confirmation.
maria-cs: Summary actions: raj - confirm route propagation by 18:00 UTC; oliver - add risk + follow-up; maria - run Thu call; jess - paste final policy into runbook. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
